clearance.derivation: systemic CL approximated by apparent oral clearance CL/F (geometric mean 34.2 L/h at 25 mg) because absolute oral bioavailability is >95% (BCS class I, well absorbed), scaled to 70 kg (34.2 L/h = 8.14 mL/min/kg)
